decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and mixing know-how, so its own R&D can interpret field feedback from heavy corrosion-protection users and refine it rather than abandon it.

The low-pressure injection pump sits squarely within the established injection and construction-repair business and has its own web page, so the firm has strong related knowledge to assimilate results and improve it.

The multi-model transfer pump line builds directly on the firm's pump engineering, and having several variants lets management learn which models perform and adjust within the line instead of withdrawing it.

Launched only in 2024 and close to the core hydraulic and two-component spraying expertise, the system is still being learned from, and the firm's in-house R&D and university cooperation give it the absorptive capacity to develop it further.
